items.prompt: Portrait of the warlord of the Ashfall Hullbreakers. A Hullbreaker, a huge hunched furred alien predator, clearly not human and not a werewolf in clothes: bear-heavy shoulders, a long wolf-like muzzle full of teeth, thick matted fur, heavy claws, small fierce eyes that shine in the dark. Scrap armour harness strapped over the fur, made of hull plates torn from other ships. Trophies are machine parts and hull plates, never skulls or bones. An old scarred alpha with grey and rust-brown fur, a riveted steel plate bolted along the lower jaw like a steel grin, heavy claws resting on a boarding hook, harness plates in clashing colours from three different fleets, chains across the chest. Painted grimdark science-fiction character portrait, oil painting with visible loose brushstrokes and palette-knife texture, dramatic chiaroscuro, square composition, three-quarter bust view, the subject lit hard from the left by dim red running lights and a red-orange engine glow, deep soft shadow on the right side, a dark painterly dark soot-black ship interior hung with chains, scrap and hull plates background softly out of focus, muted desaturated palette with one strong glow colour, museum-quality concept art for a dark space-opera strategy game. No text, no letters, no logo, no border, no frame, no watermark.

Portrait of a Glasswright elder. A Glasswright, a tall slender biological alien, plainly not human, not a grey alien and not an elf: a very long slender neck, large dark eyes behind a clear transparent second eyelid, pale skin that stores light and glows faintly in fine patterns, wearing layered robes of crystal plates and mirror-thread fabric that catch the light, small glowing light-cores worn as jewellery. A grieving dignified face, a high collar of faceted crystal, one long-fingered hand raised holding a small glowing light-core, behind her tall crystal vanes and silver mirrors that split the light into rainbow fringes. Nothing aquatic: no fins, no gills, no scales.
